name: trading-assistant
description: This repository contains the initial workspace for a local-first web application designed to support discretionary swing options trading. This root package.json is scaffolding only — not connected to frontend/'s real app or its dependency tree. Its only plausible live purpose is the root-level Playwright configs (playwright.phase1.config.ts, playwright.integration.config.ts) and the 6 specs under e2e/integration/, none of which are currently wired into CI or an npm script, and this file doesn't declare @playwright/test as a dependency either. Reviving that e2e suite or removing this file are both open decisions, not resolved here.
